children: US transportation and logistics firm's Q3 revenue rose 9%, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted diluted EPS for Q3 missed consensus estimates
Company raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $1.00-$1.10
Schneider raises full-year 2026 adj diluted EPS guidance to $1.00-$1.10
Company expects 2026 net capital expenditures of $325-$350 mln
Outlook assumes continued contract rate recovery and benefits from productivity and cost initiatives

TRUCKLOAD SEGMENT - Co said truckload earnings more than doubled, driven by improved pricing, productivity, acquisition-related cost synergies, higher gains on equipment sales, and better equipment utilization, partly offset by increased purchased transportation

INTERMODAL SEGMENT - Intermodal delivered strong earnings growth, supported by higher revenue per order from price increases and favorable freight mix, partly offset by higher purchased transportation costs
LOGISTICS SEGMENT - Logistics results were negatively affected by higher purchased transportation and insurance costs related to a prior year claim, despite higher revenue per order
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
